fields.name: __FirstSpeaker__Voice
fields.label: Who speaks first
fields.description: Choose whether the visitor or the Voice AI starts the conversation.

selectOptions.label: AI
selectOptions.description: The Voice AI opens the conversation with the introduction below.

selectOptions.label: Human
selectOptions.description: The Voice AI waits for the visitor's first message.

fields.name: __Introduction__Voice
fields.label: Introduction
fields.description: Message the Voice AI sends when the AI speaks first. Required when the AI speaks first.

fields.name: __Goal__Voice
fields.label: Goal
fields.description: What the Voice AI should achieve in the conversation.

fields.name: __Role__Voice
fields.label: Role
fields.description: Who the Voice AI is and how it should present itself.

fields.name: __Instructions__Voice
fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: Rules and guidance the Voice AI must follow.

fields.name: __ManagerAgent__Voice
fields.label: Manager Agent
fields.description: Optional manager agent name or id used when this agent hands work over.

fields.name: __EngineMode__Voice
fields.label: Engine Mode
fields.description: Choose how the agent handles speech. Realtime uses one realtime model for both listening and speaking; Pipeline chains separate speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech steps. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

selectOptions.label: Realtime
selectOptions.description: A single realtime model handles listening and speaking.

selectOptions.label: Pipeline
selectOptions.description: Separate speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech steps.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__RealtimeVoice
fields.label: Realtime Model
fields.description: Model used when Engine Mode is Realtime. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__Voice
fields.label: LLM
fields.description: Model used when Engine Mode is Pipeline. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__SpeechToText
fields.description: Speech-to-text model used when Engine Mode is Pipeline. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__TextToSpeech
fields.description: Text-to-speech model used when Engine Mode is Pipeline. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __VoiceConfig__TextToSpeech
fields.description: Voice, language, and speed used for speech in both Realtime and Pipeline modes.

fields.name: __CallRecording__Voice
fields.label: Call Recording
fields.description: Records each voice session. The setting is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __PreemptiveGeneration__Voice
fields.label: Preemptive Generation
fields.description: Starts preparing a reply before the caller finishes speaking. The setting is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __NoiseCancellation__Voice
fields.label: Noise Cancellation
fields.description: Reduces background noise in the caller audio. The setting is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

selectOptions.label: Auto
selectOptions.description: Let the platform choose the noise reduction.
